author: lkyzr
quote: i honestly wouldn't even bother writing a review, but that 99 metascore bothered me so much that i had to say something. how is this game getting a 99 when it has these kinds of issues? the performance is disappointing, with fps dropping to around 18-20 on average in my experience, and i've also had crashes. not to mention that calling a box with a download code inside a physical copy is just ridiculous. no actual disc? seriously? the whole point of buying a physical edition is owning the game physically. the graphics are impressive, sure, but that doesn't excuse the technical problems or make the game flawless. i genuinely don't understand how people can call this a 99/100 experience.
